description: This file contains CMake functions and macros related to the installation and configuration of header-only libraries and packages, including generating configuration files and package config files.

methods.name: HeaderOnlyInstallCMakeConfig
methods.description: Configures and installs a CMake config file for a target, setting dependencies and targets, and creating version files.

methods.name: HeaderOnlyInstallPackageConfig
methods.description: Generates and installs a pkg-config style configuration file for a target, including compile options, include directories, and linker flags.
